title: SCHC specs ambiguously call Rule 255 a receiver fallback for unknown rules
description: spec/03-adaptation.md, appendix-schc.md and the SCHC draft imply unknown compressed Rule IDs can trigger Rule255 fallback while another clause requires drop. Clarify Rule255 is sender-selected before transmission for a validated IPv6 packet; receivers MUST drop unknown IDs and never reinterpret opaque residue.
